question: A shop sells apples for 35p each. Sam buys 7 apples and pays with a £5 note. How much change does Sam get, in pounds?
A train leaves at 09:40 and arrives at 13:15 on the same day. How many minutes does the journey take?
A recipe for 4 people uses 300 grams of flour. How many grams of flour are needed for 10 people?
A jacket costs £80. It is reduced by 25%, and then a further 10% is taken off the reduced price. What is the final price, in pounds?
A full tank holds 240 litres. A tap drains water out at 12 litres per minute while a hose adds water at 4 litres per minute. How many minutes until the tank is empty?
Mia is 3 times as old as her son. In 12 years, she will be twice as old as him. How old is Mia now?
A rectangle has a perimeter of 46 cm. Its length is 5 cm more than its width. What is its area, in square centimetres?
Lily reads 15 pages on Monday. Each day after that she reads 5 more pages than the day before. How many pages has she read in total by the end of Sunday (Monday to Sunday)?
A bat and a ball cost £1.10 in total. The bat costs £1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost, in pence?
If 5 machines take 5 minutes to make 5 widgets, how many minutes would it take 100 machines to make 100 widgets?
Ben has twice as many marbles as Cara. Cara has 6 more marbles than Dev. Together the three of them have 70 marbles. How many marbles does Ben have?
A car drives 120 km to a town at 60 km/h, then drives the same 120 km back at 40 km/h. What is its average speed for the whole round trip, in km/h?
A notebook and a pen cost £2.30 in total. The notebook costs £2.00 more than the pen. How much does the pen cost, in pence?
If 8 printers take 8 minutes to print 8 posters, how many minutes would it take 40 printers to print 40 posters?
A cyclist rides 30 km to a village at 15 km/h, then rides the same 30 km back at 10 km/h. What is her average speed for the whole round trip, in km/h?
A patch of weeds doubles in size every day. It covers the whole field on day 24. On which day did it cover a quarter of the field?
A shop had 23 lamps. All but 8 were sold. How many lamps does the shop have left?

Priya is 34 and drives a blue car that is 6 years old. She buys 4 new tyres at £62 each and pays a £15 fitting fee for the whole job. Her friend Tom paid £300 for his tyres last year. How much does Priya pay in total, in pounds?

A school has 28 classrooms and a football pitch 100 metres long. Year 7 has 6 classes of 30 pupils. Each Year 7 pupil needs 3 exercise books, and the books come in packs of 10. How many packs must the school buy for Year 7?

A bakery opened in 2009 and has 5 staff. It bakes 144 rolls every morning and sells them in bags of 6. On Tuesday, 3 staff were off sick and the bakery sold 19 bags. How many rolls were left unsold on Tuesday?
Phone contract A costs £18 per month plus a one-off £90 setup fee. Contract B costs £24 per month with no setup fee. After how many months will the two contracts have cost exactly the same in total?
A water bottle is 40% full. After 300 ml of water is added, it is 70% full. What is the full capacity of the bottle, in ml?
In a class, the ratio of boys to girls is 3:5. There are 12 more girls than boys. How many pupils are in the class altogether?
A shop increases a price by 20%, then later reduces the new price by 20%. The final price is £96. What was the original price, in pounds?
Ed leaves home at 08:00 and walks along a path at 5 km/h. His sister leaves the same house at 08:30 and cycles along the same path at 15 km/h. How many minutes after 08:00 does she catch up with him?
A rope 7.2 metres long is cut into pieces that are each 45 cm long. How many pieces are there?
The average of five numbers is 18. When one number is removed, the average of the remaining four numbers is 16. What number was removed?
One tap fills a bath in 12 minutes. A second tap fills the same bath in 6 minutes. How many minutes does it take to fill the bath with both taps on together?
How many minutes are there between 22:50 on Monday and 01:20 on Tuesday?
A runner goes round a 400 m track at a steady 5 metres per second. How many complete laps does she finish in 27 minutes?
A test has 40 questions. Sana got 85% of them right. Jake got 7 more questions wrong than Sana. How many questions did Jake get right?
Adult cinema tickets cost £9 and child tickets cost £6. A group of 11 people paid £81 in total. How many children were in the group?
An item costs £40 before VAT. VAT of 20% is added, and then a 15% discount voucher is applied to the price including VAT. What is the final price, in pounds?
1 March is a Wednesday. What is the date (the day of the month) of the third Friday in March?
A straight fence is 60 metres long. There is a post every 4 metres, including one post at each end. How many posts are there?
